# REK Therapy, Tracy Croghan, LICSW

> Telehealth therapy for women in Nebraska. Specialties include the emotional side of GLP-1 medications and weight loss (body image, identity, food relationship), narcissistic family dynamics, anxiety, depression, and life transitions. Accepts Blue Cross Blue Shield of Nebraska, UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, and private pay. Telehealth only.

## Key pages
- [Home, services, and booking](https://www.rektherapy.com/): about Tracy, services, insurance, FAQ, and how to request an appointment
- [Blog](https://www.rektherapy.com/blog): articles on emotional wellbeing and GLP-1 medications
- [The Emotional Side of GLP-1 Medications](https://www.rektherapy.com/blog/emotional-side-of-glp-1-medications): body image, identity, food, mood, and how therapy can help

## Notes
- Tracy Croghan is a Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker (LICSW). She does not prescribe medication or give nutrition advice.
- This site does not provide crisis services. In a crisis, call or text 988.
